intro.title: RTK Query — Data Fetching & Cache
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple React app that fetches and displays a list of posts from a mock API. You will learn how to use RTK Query, a powerful data fetching and caching tool from Redux Toolkit, to manage server state efficiently. The core concepts include setting up an API service, defining endpoints, and using auto-generated hooks to fetch data with built-in loading and error states. By the end, you'll understand how RTK Query simplifies data fetching, reduces boilerplate code, and automatically caches responses to optimize performance.
intro.usecase: RTK Query's data fetching and caching patterns are essential for building responsive dashboards like those in analytics platforms (Google Analytics, Mixpanel) where multiple charts need synchronized data without redundant API calls. E-commerce product listing pages use this pattern to cache search results and filter states while maintaining real-time inventory updates. Social media feeds implement similar caching to instantly display previously loaded posts while fetching new content in the background, creating seamless user experiences.
